PLAYER DIRECT OOC CRITICISM OF THE DM at Day293~17:30 Caer Veylan eastern approach in response to unnecessary 200gp extension request: "DM That doesnt even make any sense, they've had plenty of time to recover make their way to wherever they need to go". This does NOT authorize V to send new orders, sign bills, teleport patients, magically cure experimental injuries, speak to anyone in-world, spend class/personal resources, or change V itinerary. DM correction resolves prior omitted INDEPENDENT caretaker/patient progress over ALREADY ELAPSED Days285–293 without advancing Day293 game clock, replaying or recharging resources, and preserves a real risk of some patient medical needs. Grounding in immutable PLAY-REC-D285-V-ASKS-SEDGECROSS-LONGTERM-CARE-HOME-ROUTES-001.json and PLAY-REC-D285-V-FUNDS-SEDGECROSS-CARE-HANDOFF-DEPARTS-EASTWATCH-001.json: eight ambulatory patients identified P1–P6,P10,P11; three patient IDs P7,P8,P9 were nonambulatory/needed flat carts at handoff; all eleven left free and voluntarily in Sedgecross keeper+sick-tender civilian care; V explicitly PAID 200gp for 14 nights Day285–299 including lodging56gp, meals92gp4sp, nursing28gp, Caer Veylan civilian recovery-home trustee OUTBOUND inquiry postage1gp and capped entrusted future transport/postage contingency22gp6sp. The caretaker, not V, accepted responsibility for normal outpatient coordination, safety/consented family contacts and real medical assessment; keeper's outgoing inquiry was waiting next road carrier at original Day285 departure, and V also had delivered optional Blackthorn lodging/work invitation to all eleven before leaving, without coerced relocation or reply. Prior message at Day293 wrongly framed this bridge as 11 unchanged patients all needing new 14 nights/200gp despite eight days of autonomous service and existing paid contingency. 
INDEPENDENT BACKGROUND RESOLUTION (already elapsed, explicit DM administration correction not new present-party scene): D286 local normal road courier collects already paid humanitarian inquiry; estimated established Caer Veylan road connection and normal delivery with real transit leads to trustee RECEIPT around D288, no instant bird magic. Trustee considers the existing uncommitted resources (potential two ordinary patient carts/two horses/three carers in earlier PREP, not guaranteed deployment) and independently performs availability assessment D289. PREDECLARED logistic DC13, modifier+3 for professional regional outreach/capacity, GENUINE executed Python secrets d20 FACE5+3=8 FAIL => full two-cart/three-carer arrangement NOT CONFIRMED for immediate dispatch; trustee informs keeper through ordinary reply by D292 on normal road service. This DOES NOT prove permanent refusal, no willingness ever, lack of partial/alternative local health transport, foreign military report, or death/capture of patient; no transport booked, no nonconsensual patient data transferred. Keeper and sick-tender continue ordinary local referral and inquiries without needing V to chase paperwork or issue second blanket authority. No special priced transport invoice or use of restricted22gp6sp contingency was actually agreed/paid yet; held intact.
For each of the eight PREVIOUSLY ALREADY AMBULATORY consenting survivors P1–P6,P10,P11, determine voluntary departure by DAY293 via independent mundane family/community contacts, civilian caravans and personal preference, no military risk guaranteed away. Outcome table fixed before dice: d20 1–6 remains in care while identifying secure destination, 7–11 has an accepted onward civilian plan but DEPARTURE PENDING, 12–20 has physically LEFT SEDGECROSS on a credible civilian travel arrangement with own/helper assistance BY DAY293 (not guaranteed reached destination or proof of legal safety). GENUINELY EXECUTED Python secrets d20 faces in stable P ID order: P1=19 departed, P2=8 plan/wait, P3=10 plan/wait, P4=10 plan/wait, P5=13 departed, P6=17 departed, P10=9 plan/wait, P11=3 still seeking safe contact. So three ambulatory patients have VOLUNTARILY DEPARTED by D293 (P1/P5/P6; not asserted safely arrived home), four P2/P3/P4/P10 have concrete mutually accepted travel plans but still Sedgecross awaiting ordinary departure (no invented exact paid carrier bill or date), one P11 remains and wants a reliable safe route rather than being forced into unknown checkpoint. This preserves earlier expressed patient P4 concern about families implicated and P7 wishes for relatives notified, without inventing named kin, current city of residence or Neri's contact role. None compelled into Blackthorn employment; no promise they all choose same destination.
Three previously NONAMBULATORY patients P7,P8,P9 after eight ordinary days of sick-tender care independently medically re-assessed for ability to TRANSFER with assistance (not a miracle cure or automatic walking recovery). PREDECLARED independent d20+2 vs DC15 per patient for ordinary functional progress; genuine Python secrets rolls P7 face5+2=7 fails, P8 face9+2=11 fails, P9 face11+2=13 fails. They remain ALIVE, medically STABLE but NEED STRETCHER/FLAT transport and supported continuing care as of D293; absence of progress on THIS DC is not new worsening/death and no high-tier magic asserted. They remain in original paid care, not abandoned. The dedicated trustee full cart team was not yet secured, so must continue to find ordinary qualified professional placement/carts within remaining paid period or negotiate actual continuation with credible provider if necessary, not preemptively demand 200gp from V. The other five ambulatory at Sedgecross are counted under prepaid meals/lodging but reduction in heads does not automatically refund an already settled prepaid block; don't fabricate receipts, refunds, income or independent trust payout. Existing keeper has 22gp6sp contingency held unused for later actual agreed transport/postage; nursing+lodging rights through Day299 preserved regardless of patient departure.
NO in-world new letter, magical relay, report or Sending Stone contact to V at Caer Veylan has been confirmed. This adjudication is DM-level retrospective state of what the independent civilians have been DOING between Days285 and293, not information V magically knows without a real later communication or actual visit; user asks DM to address absurd static-care concern, so out-of-character summary given. Cirren Day293 reminder that care term ends D299 remains factually true, but framing that ALL ELEVEN still needed identical extension is explicitly OVERRIDDEN/corrected and never should require reflexive second200gp check. V's last actual CURRENT position remains D293~17:30 EASTERN APPROACH to CAER VEYLAN in owned coach, with current bound route FIRST Lady Elara Rethwyn rural manor southwest of Caereth, then Caereth then Orsaven; no city inn or purchase/departure, no new days/rolls, old trip events unchanged. V resources: HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Superiority4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 first free Whispers1/1; cloak Protection and on-person attuned Luckstone2/3, Fenar59/59HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40, Cirren51/51 full L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3 CD2/2, Mara and4 horses coach intact, 429gp1sp6cp purse, packed9 companion ration person-days and12 horse feed-animal-days, PixieDust1 sealed, LongRest3/6 as of Dawn293. Kestrel original evidence V-held private, Mara Neri/Hall notes, Fenar six reagent vials+silver tool, Cirren original Day233 Rethwyn compact. Signed Nightglass scholarly commission100gp advance received, prospective300+800 pending, House Severin three-house memorandum priority pigeon forwarding toward Lady Elara no receipt; Orsaven field-book request no receipt. 
NEXT actual V action continues at Caer Veylan approach, free to enter secured city for lodging/resupply or travel, and not stopped for Sedgecross housekeeping. If evidence later confirms actual material shortfall with outstanding patients, competent civilian workers may communicate an actionable real quote through valid channels for user to decide; never invent second full14-night reservation because of bookkeeping deadline.
